NFL team home airports

Source: R/data.R
nfl_airports.Rd

A reference table mapping each NFL team to its home (or nearest major) airport, with coordinates and an IANA time zone. Used by calculate_travel_miles() as the origin of each team's travel.

Usage

nfl_airports

Format

A tibble with 32 rows and 8 variables:

team

Three-letter team abbreviation (nflverse convention).

airport

IATA airport code.

airport_name

Full airport name.

city

City served by the airport.

latitude

Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude

Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

time_zone

IANA time zone name (e.g. "America/Chicago").

home_stadium_id

The team's usual home venue, joinable to nfl_stadiums.

Source

Compiled from public IATA/FAA airport reference data; see data-raw/nfl_airports.R for the build script.

Examples

nfl_airports
#> # A tibble: 32 x 8
#>    team  airport airport_name city  latitude longitude time_zone home_stadium_id
#>    <chr> <chr>   <chr>        <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>     <chr>          
#>  1 ARI   PHX     Phoenix Sky~ Phoe~     33.4    -112.  America/~ PHO00          
#>  2 ATL   ATL     Hartsfield-~ Atla~     33.6     -84.4 America/~ ATL97          
#>  3 BAL   BWI     Baltimore/W~ Balt~     39.2     -76.7 America/~ BAL00          
#>  4 BUF   BUF     Buffalo Nia~ Buff~     42.9     -78.7 America/~ BUF00          
#>  5 CAR   CLT     Charlotte D~ Char~     35.2     -80.9 America/~ CAR00          
#>  6 CHI   ORD     Chicago O'H~ Chic~     42.0     -87.9 America/~ CHI98          
#>  7 CIN   CVG     Cincinnati/~ Cinc~     39.0     -84.7 America/~ CIN00          
#>  8 CLE   CLE     Cleveland H~ Clev~     41.4     -81.8 America/~ CLE00          
#>  9 DAL   DFW     Dallas/Fort~ Dall~     32.9     -97.0 America/~ DAL00          
#> 10 DEN   DEN     Denver Inte~ Denv~     39.9    -105.  America/~ DEN00          
#> # i 22 more rows

# A single team's home airport
subset(nfl_airports, team == "KC")
#> # A tibble: 1 x 8
#>   team  airport airport_name  city  latitude longitude time_zone home_stadium_id
#>   <chr> <chr>   <chr>         <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>     <chr>          
#> 1 KC    MCI     Kansas City ~ Kans~     39.3     -94.7 America/~ KAN00
